Growth Product Manager - Consumer
Company: KharchaApp is a fast-growing Indian personal finance and cashback app (Bengaluru, Karnataka) with 8M+ downloads and 3M MAUs, targeting Tier 1 and Tier 2 Indian cities and backed by a leading consumer-focused VC.

Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka (Hybrid)
Compensation: INR 22-32 LPA + ESOPs

About the Role:
We are looking for a Growth PM to accelerate user acquisition, activation, and retention across our Android and iOS apps. You will own the full funnel with a specific focus on organic growth channels (App Store Optimisation, referral) and engagement loops. A strong understanding of India's digital consumer - including Tier 2 users and Hindi-language audiences - is highly valued.

Responsibilities:
- Own the growth roadmap spanning acquisition (ASO, referral programs, performance marketing integration) and retention (push notifications, gamification, re-engagement)
- Design and run A/B tests across onboarding, activation, and core engagement loops to improve funnel conversion
- Conduct cohort analysis and retention modeling to identify behavioural signals that predict long-term user value
- Partner with the marketing team on channel attribution and integrate insights into product decisions
- Localise product experiences for Hindi-speaking and regional language users; champion inclusive design for Bharat users
- Present growth metrics, experiment results, and strategic proposals to the founding team weekly

Requirements:
- 3+ years of product management experience, with at least 1 year in a growth or lifecycle role (required)
- Strong analytical skills and proficiency with SQL for funnel and cohort analysis (required)
- Hands-on experience with A/B testing and statistical analysis of experiment results (required)
- Understanding of App Store Optimisation (ASO) principles for Google Play and App Store (required)
- Familiarity with the Indian digital consumer market, including Tier 2/3 user behaviour and regional language considerations (required)

Nice to have:
- Experience with push notification and in-app messaging tools (CleverTap, MoEngage, or Braze)
- Knowledge of mobile attribution platforms (AppsFlyer, Adjust)
- Understanding of UPI-linked financial products and how cashback mechanics drive engagement
- Fluency in Hindi or a major Indian regional language
- Prior experience at an Indian consumer fintech or super-app
